headlines.title: Democrats Face Big Test in Critical Michigan Primary
headlines.description: It is primary day in a handful of states and voters are heading to the polls with key races up for grabs that could signal which direction the parties are headed before the November midterms. One of the most closely watched contests is taking place in Michigan, which has become the Democrat’s most expensive Senate primary race ever. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports and Steve Kornacki joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination
headlines.description: Republicans on the Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve in the role permanently. NBC News' Scott Wong and Gabe Gutierrez have details on what senators had to say in support or opposition of the nomination and when it will face a full Senate vote.

headlines.title: Olympic canoeist charged by Jeanine Pirro seeks to permanently sink Reflecting Pool case
headlines.description: Attorneys for the former Olympic canoeist the Trump administration had charged in a felony Reflecting Pool case are seeking to permanently bar any effort to resurface what they called a “politically motivated prosecution” of their client.

headlines.title: West Coast Wildfires Rage on as Arson Suspect Arrested
headlines.description: Police have announced the arrest of a man on suspicion of arson, connected to one of the wildfires burning out of control in Washington state. As dozens of fires burn across the West, conditions spawned a rare “firenado,” a twister of flames caught on video. NBC’s Morgan Chesky reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the latest forecast.

headlines.title: Rep. Max Miller calls for House investigation into himself amid abuse allegations
headlines.description: Ohio Rep. Max Miller denies all allegations of domestic abuse by his ex-wife and has called for a House Ethics investigation into himself. Miller said he will not drop his re-election bid. NBC News' Scott Wong reports.

headlines.title: SpaceX hit by surging AI costs as insiders prepare to sell their shares
headlines.description: For a rocket company, SpaceX is spending a lot of money to build out its AI capacities.

headlines.title: McDonald’s struggles to attract bargain-hungry customers
headlines.description: McDonald’s just reported its slowest U.S. sales growth in over a year as its value push fell flat with customers who continue to struggle with higher prices.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Democrats put redistricting amendment on Maryland’s midterm ballot
headlines.description: Maryland’s Democratic-controlled Legislature voted Tuesday to place a constitutional amendment on the November ballot that would pave the way for them to eliminate the state’s lone Republican-held congressional district before the 2028 election.

headlines.title: WWE Hall of Famer Dory Funk Jr. dead at 85
headlines.description: Old school wrestling great Dory Funk Jr., who followed his legendary dad’s footsteps onto the canvas and then forged a decades-spanning, globe-trotting career, has died, officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Two more House Democrats face primary danger: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
